title: test_plan.md
content:
# Validation Checklist

- [ ] The only `.html` file is `ActiveWorkspace.html`.
- [ ] No private MOL credential literal occurs anywhere in the package.
- [ ] Backend player response does not render or inject MOL navigation.
- [ ] Backend MOL response injects MOL Sessions while preserving Encounter, Dice, Characters, Alignment, Quest Journal, and Account.
- [ ] MOL can choose a character and join the encounter as a player token.
- [ ] Eleven distinct accounts cannot join one lobby.
- [ ] Player A cannot move Player B's token.
- [ ] Players cannot move hostile tokens.
- [ ] Hostiles roll initiative automatically.
- [ ] Players roll initiative from Dice and totals appear on Encounter.
- [ ] Hostile turns automatically pathfind, roll attack/damage, update HP, log results, and advance.
- [ ] Player rolls made on Dice appear in Encounter Rolls and Encounter Record.
- [ ] Map image upload displays beneath the square grid.
- [ ] Blank map creation and wall/difficult/water/hazard/cover painting work.
- [ ] JSON/CSV/TXT encounter and quest imports work.
- [ ] Token fallback renders initials when a GitHub image is missing.
- [ ] Desktop, tablet, portrait mobile, and landscape mobile layouts remain usable.
